subject.title: RPC bridge send intermittently delivers one send request twice (~15–30%; two GUIDs, fixed ~60ms gap)

question: Should the duplicate-send fix wait for physical-delivery proof from the reproducing SIP-disabled Mac before this issue is resolved?
rationale: The source repair path is clear, but only the reproducing macOS bridge setup can prove the IMCore physical delivery behavior that triggered the report.

options.title: Wait for live delivery proof
options.body: Keep this issue open and require redacted request, response, outbound-row, unique-GUID, and duplicate-text counts before landing the candidate fix.

options.title: Accept source-only risk
options.body: Maintainers could merge the candidate based on source tests and green CI, but they would own any remaining live IMCore duplicate-send regression.

recommendation.title: Wait for live delivery proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require redacted request, response, outbound-row, unique-GUID, and duplicate-text counts before landing the candidate fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the active fix candidate and already requested the exact proof gate from the reporter.
